functions.name: Start engine from command line
functions.behaviour: Starts the local engine on 127.0.0.1 (default port 6006, 0 picks a free port), loads and verifies the model assets, opens the session directory, prints the launch URL with a one-time token and opens the browser unless suppressed. Refuses non-64-bit or pre-3.11 Python.
functions.notes: --data defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%/C600Studio (home dir elsewhere); --launch-info writes launch metadata plus a .status.json stage file (loading_assets, opening_session, binding_loopback, ready, stopped). Environment C600_LAUNCH_ID supplies the launch id, otherwise a random one is made.

functions.name: Open session directory and journal at startup
functions.behaviour: Opening the data directory takes an exclusive engine lock, opens (or creates) the SQLite journal in WAL mode, creates the Solved root event and checkpoint for a new session, or replays the journal from the nearest checkpoint for an existing one; a session from a different model id is refused.
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_crash.py and tests/test_core.py exercise reopen/recovery; a second engine on the same directory fails in SessionLock (session_lock.py:12).

functions.name: Engine stops on Ctrl+C or termination signal
functions.behaviour: SIGINT/SIGTERM request a graceful shutdown: stop accepting work, cancel the running job, close the listener, pause the timer and close the session and lock.

functions.name: Engine stops when the owning parent pipe closes
functions.behaviour: When started with C600_WATCH_PARENT_STDIN=1 the engine polls its stdin pipe and shuts down gracefully when the parent closes it or exits.

functions.name: Health check
functions.behaviour: Authenticated reply with protocol, ready flag, pid, launch id, model id and the interpreter in use; launchers use it to confirm readiness.

functions.name: Shut down the engine over HTTP
functions.behaviour: POST with the matching launch id sets the engine to stop and replies {stopping:true}; wrong launch id is refused 403. Further write requests are answered 503.

functions.name: Cancel the running analysis job
functions.behaviour: Sets the cancel flag; a running preview, import, scramble or similar job raises 'Analysis cancelled; puzzle state unchanged'.

functions.name: Poll an analysis job
functions.behaviour: Returns {done:false} while a job runs, then {done:true,result} or {done:true,error}; unknown id gives 404.

functions.name: Serve the launch page
functions.behaviour: GET / with the right ?token= returns web/index.html; a missing or wrong token is refused. Host header must equal the bound loopback address.

functions.name: Serve web scripts and style
functions.behaviour: Serves only app.js, renderer.js, worker.js, workbench.js and style.css from web/; any other name is 404.

functions.name: Serve model mesh assets
functions.behaviour: Serves the fixed list of mesh/frame/slot/normal asset files (mesh.json, mesh_vertices.f32, mesh_sticker.u32, mesh_centers.f32, cell_frames.f32, slot_piece.u32, cell_normals.f32); anything else 404.

functions.name: Puzzle structure
functions.behaviour: Returns the 600-cell structure document: 600 colors, 120 vertices, adjacency, vertex incidence and geometry.

functions.name: Session status
functions.behaviour: Returns the full status: head, revision, state hash, solved flags, per-orbit progress, preferences, inspection and focus info, totals, up to 100 checkpoints, pending preview, can_undo/can_redo.

functions.name: Move history list
functions.behaviour: Lists journal events newest first (page of up to 100 with next_before cursor) with id, parent, depth, note, assistance, primitive count, stars, post hash and time.

functions.name: Session statistics
functions.behaviour: Returns scramble versus solution primitive counts, stars, operation count, assisted transaction count and the timer.

functions.name: Orbit catalog
functions.behaviour: Lists the 35 orbits with rank, sticker and piece counts, orientation, seed length, formula and collateral orbits.

functions.name: Cell grips
functions.behaviour: For a chosen cell returns the 11 nonidentity cap rotations as legal H/T words grouped into seven axes with forward/inverse controls, labels, angle and 4D axis vectors.
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_v02.py; cell is zero-based, default 0.

functions.name: Cap mask
functions.behaviour: Returns a per-piece 0/1 byte mask (in sticker-slot order) of positions whose cap includes the chosen cell.

functions.name: Native mapping table
functions.behaviour: Returns the verified native-to-lab sticker and face maps, profile hash and matched counts; error if the native bridge has not passed.

functions.name: Native snapshot (colors, styles, interaction)
functions.behaviour: Returns the native-order colors, render styles and interactive flags with state and cell status, as a full snapshot or (protocol 2 with since=<revision>) a delta; keeps at most four bases.
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_native_snapshot.py, tests/test_native_snapshot_cache.py. protocol=1 or 2; since only with 2.

functions.name: Native colors / styles arrays
functions.behaviour: Returns native-order little-endian int16 colors (/api/native/colors) or uint8 render styles (/api/native/styles) as raw bytes.

functions.name: Raw sticker labels
functions.behaviour: Returns all 259,800 current sticker labels as little-endian uint32 bytes.

functions.name: Raw render styles
functions.behaviour: Returns the per-slot render styles (filter result with pinned buffers, preview support, selection, inspection annotations) as bytes.

functions.name: Download macro certificate
functions.behaviour: Downloads macro_certificate.c600.json for the pending preview: certificate with source/destination arrays and expanded primitive word; error when no preview is pending.

functions.name: Download session export
functions.behaviour: Downloads session.c600.json.gz: the active-branch events with recipes and hashes, final state hash and preferences. Refused when the history exceeds the importable budget (10,000 transactions or 2,000,000 primitives).

functions.name: Download proof log (C600)
functions.behaviour: Downloads session.c600.json.gz, the gzip proof log of the active branch.
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_log_budget.py. format defaults to c600.

functions.name: Download MPUlt log
functions.behaviour: Downloads session.log in MPUltimate v1 text format, built from the history and the current colors through the verified native bridge, with timer in milliseconds; capped at 10,000 primitive moves; needs a passed native bridge.

functions.name: Save preferences
functions.behaviour: Validates and stores preference changes (active orbit, filter rules, pin safety, protected orbits, selected piece, inspection, focus color, camera, keybinds, presets, view, layout, bookmarks, named sets, macro library, profiles); unknown keys or invalid values are refused; puzzle labels are never changed.
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_http_boundary.py, tests/test_orbit_switch_atomic.py. This is also the only route that sets protected orbits (protected list, each 0..34).

functions.name: Focus a physical cell color
functions.behaviour: Sets or clears the focus color (C1..C600 or null) used for highlighting.

functions.name: Preview filter rules
functions.behaviour: Counts what a filter expression or rule list would show (matched/visible/added/removed pieces and stickers, per orbit) without applying it; returns a context hash. Expression language is parsed by core Filters (orbit, rank, stickers, set, cap, shell, color, cell, adjacent, layer, home_layer, home, current, piece, position, active, unsolved, solved, buffer, protected, preview, selected and boolean operators).

functions.name: Apply filter rules
functions.behaviour: Applies a previously previewed rule list if the context hash is still current, and turns off extra pin context.

functions.name: Clear inspection annotation
functions.behaviour: Removes the inspection annotation from preferences.

functions.name: Reset to solved
functions.behaviour: Returns to the solved state at the root, keeping a recoverable 'Before reset' checkpoint and all preferences; optionally stores a validated camera.
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_log_workflow.py, tests/test_frame_preferences.py. Body may carry camera (validated by log_io.validate_camera). Reset to head 0 also invalidates any pending preview and redo stack.

functions.name: Save log to disk (C600)
functions.behaviour: Writes a C600 proof log file into the session logs folder with a timestamped name (atomic write) and returns its path, size and sha256.
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_log_workflow.py; format defaults to c600.

functions.name: Save log to disk (MPUlt)
functions.behaviour: Writes a .log file in MPUltimate v1 format into the session logs folder.

functions.name: Import log (C600)
functions.behaviour: Replays an uploaded base64 gzip or plain C600 proof log, verifying every state hash, then installs it as a new branch with a recovery checkpoint of the previous state; log preferences are not imported. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_log_workflow.py, tests/test_recovery_camera.py. Body: data_base64, format, optional camera; limits 16 MiB packed, 24 MiB expanded, 10,000 transactions, 2,000,000 primitives.

functions.name: Import log (MPUlt)
functions.behaviour: Validates a MPUltimate v1 full-600-cell log (header, description, colors, CRC, move tokens) against the native bridge, replays all moves, and installs the history as a new branch whose redo tail is kept; checkpoint of the previous state is retained. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_mpult_log.py. Capped at 10,000 native moves.

functions.name: Import session record
functions.behaviour: Imports an in-body JSON session record (as downloaded from the export) by full replay and installs it as a new branch with a recovery checkpoint. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).

functions.name: Checkout a journal head
functions.behaviour: Moves the puzzle to any saved journal head (any branch) by replaying from the nearest checkpoint with hash verification. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_log_workflow.py, tests/test_v02.py. Also clears the pending preview and the redo stack.

functions.name: Session timer start
functions.behaviour: Starts the explicit session timer (persisted).
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_v02.py, tests/test_log_workflow.py. Stored value is meta timer_seconds; unknown action refused; default action is status.

functions.name: Session timer pause
functions.behaviour: Pauses the session timer and saves the total.
functions.notes: Same route and engine call as start; test: tests/test_v02.py.

functions.name: Session timer status
functions.behaviour: Returns elapsed seconds and running flag.
functions.notes: Same route and engine call as start; test: tests/test_v02.py.

functions.name: Session timer heartbeat
functions.behaviour: Returns elapsed seconds and saves the total if five seconds passed since the last save.
functions.notes: Same route and engine call as start; test: tests/test_v02.py.

functions.name: Save a named set
functions.behaviour: Evaluates a filter expression and stores the matching pieces (by identity or by position, at most 10,000) as a named set usable in filters.

functions.name: Compose macros
functions.behaviour: Builds a pending preview from recipe a (and b): inverse of a, commutator a b a' b', conjugate a b a', or concatenation a b. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_v02.py. Result carries a commit token like preview.

functions.name: Save pending preview as a macro
functions.behaviour: Stores the pending previewed recipe under a name (1..80 characters) in the macro library preferences, with effect hash and support.

functions.name: Random scramble preview or apply
functions.behaviour: Builds a random legal word of 1..10,000 moves (seed optional) and returns it as a preview; with apply=true it commits immediately. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Tests: tests/test_scramble.py, tests/test_log_workflow.py. apply=false only writes the pending preview in memory (writes: none persistent); apply=true commits and fails if a protected orbit moves.

functions.name: Native handshake
functions.behaviour: Verifies the native MPUlt bridge description against the model and stores the verified profile (all 259,800 stickers and 1,200 generators matched) for the native routes; body up to 64 MiB. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).

functions.name: Native select
functions.behaviour: Selects the piece at a clicked native sticker and saves it as the selected preference; hidden stickers are refused.

functions.name: Native inspect: home-centers
functions.behaviour: Inspects a clicked native sticker with gesture home-centers (shows the home cell centers of the clicked piece); sets the inspection annotation and focus color; stale view or profile or hidden sticker is refused.

functions.name: Native inspect: required-piece
functions.behaviour: Inspects a clicked native sticker with gesture required-piece (shows the piece required at the clicked destination and, if available, its buffer analysis); sets the inspection annotation and focus color; stale view or profile or hidden sticker is refused.
functions.notes: Same route and engine call as home-centers; test: tests/test_color_inspection.py.

functions.name: Native turn
functions.behaviour: Applies a batch (1..10,000) of native MPUlt move tokens as one previewed and committed transaction ('Native MPUlt turn'); stale pre_state is refused; fails if a protected orbit would move.

functions.name: Native snapshot piggyback on any POST
functions.behaviour: A POST body carrying native_since gets the snapshot (delta against that revision) added to the reply as native_snapshot after the operation runs.

functions.name: Preview a macro
functions.behaviour: Computes the net permutation of a recipe of words and stars, certifies it and returns a certificate (support by orbit, conflicts with protected orbits, counts, hashes) plus a commit token; nothing is committed. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_core.py. Pending preview is in memory only.

functions.name: Suggest next insertion
functions.behaviour: Asks the planner for the next 1..50 insertion steps for an orbit (optional target position) and previews them; reports complete when the orbit is solved. Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).

functions.name: Commit the pending preview
functions.behaviour: Commits the pending preview given its token: refuses stale previews and any move touching a protected orbit; writes the event durably, may write an automatic checkpoint every 50 moves, clears redo.

functions.name: Cancel the pending preview
functions.behaviour: Discards the pending preview and returns status.

functions.name: Undo
functions.behaviour: Reverts the last committed transaction by applying its inverse, verifying the pre-state hash; refused at the solved root.

functions.name: Redo
functions.behaviour: Re-applies the next transaction, from the redo stack, the stored redo pointer, or the only child; if several branches exist the user must choose one in History.

functions.name: Create checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Saves a named snapshot of the current state and preferences (default timestamped name, 120 chars); the 'Solved root' checkpoint cannot be overwritten away from root.

functions.name: Restore checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Restores state, head and preferences from a named checkpoint after hash verification; clears pending preview and redo.

functions.name: Back up the session database
functions.behaviour: Writes a timestamped SQLite backup copy of the session database into the session directory and returns its path and size.

functions.name: Buffer analysis
functions.behaviour: Returns buffer pieces, the chosen target (automatic or explicit), candidate star nodes with setup path and length, guard cells and collateral orbits for an orbit.

functions.name: Piece at position
functions.behaviour: Returns the piece description (occupant, orbit, home/current/cap cells, slots, labels, correctness) at a position.

functions.name: Track piece by identity
functions.behaviour: Returns the piece description at the current position of the piece with a given identity.

functions.name: Find required piece
functions.behaviour: Returns the piece that currently occupies the home of a given position (where that identity is).
functions.notes: Body field is position; implementation is identical to track-piece (uses state.where[p]).

functions.name: Next unsolved piece in an orbit
functions.behaviour: Steps to the next or previous unsolved position within an orbit (wrapping) after a given position and returns its description.

functions.name: Select piece
functions.behaviour: Selects a piece by position, saves it as the selected preference and returns its description.

functions.name: Load the demo scramble
functions.behaviour: Previews the recorded verified seed-600 1,000-move scramble; only allowed at head 0 (solved root). Runs as a background job: the reply is {job:id}, the client polls GET /api/job/<id>; only one job at a time (409 otherwise).
functions.notes: Commit is a separate step; reads assets/demo_scramble.json.

functions.name: HTTP request guard
functions.behaviour: Every POST needs matching Host, launch token, same-origin Origin, JSON content type, a JSON object body, and size within 24 MiB (64 MiB for handshake); GET API routes need the token; responses carry no-store and a restrictive content security policy; unknown routes return 404/400.
functions.notes: Test: tests/test_http_boundary.py. Applies to every route; listed once.

functions.name: Job queue for long operations
functions.behaviour: Preview, suggest, import, log import, demo, checkout, compose, scramble and native handshake run on one worker thread; a second long request is refused while one is running; cancellable.

internal_only.name: PuzzleState
internal_only.reason: Used by every session route; no entry point of its own

internal_only.name: Model (mechanics, witnesses, star nets, caches)
internal_only.reason: Reached through route POST /api/preview, /api/commit, /api/suggest, /api/undo, import routes

internal_only.name: Planner (next insertion, buffer info)
internal_only.reason: Reached through route POST /api/suggest and POST /api/buffers

internal_only.name: Filters expression language
internal_only.reason: Reached through route POST /api/filter-preview, /api/filter-apply, /api/save-set and preferences rules

internal_only.name: core helpers canonical, digest, state_hash, invword, invrecipe, permutation algebra
SessionLock
internal_only.reason: Constructed by Session.__init__ at engine start (cli server.py --data)

internal_only.name: Session journal recovery
internal_only.reason: Called by Session.__init__ at engine start

internal_only.name: Session.inspection_info / validate_inspection / focus_info / cell_status / filter_context
internal_only.reason: Reached through route GET /api/status, native snapshot and route POST /api/native/inspect

internal_only.name: Session.interactive_styles / render_styles / filter_styles
internal_only.reason: Reached through route GET /api/styles and native routes

internal_only.name: mpult_log helpers (description, serialize, checksum, profile_data, normalize_description)
internal_only.reason: Reached through route GET /api/log/export format=mpult and route POST /api/log/import format=mpult

internal_only.reason: Library used by the launcher and test harnesses (other shard) to run cli server.py; no user-facing entry point in this file

internal_only.reason: Called by EngineProcess; redact is also used by server.py startup output

internal_only.reason: Writes the --launch-info files at engine start

internal_only.reason: Request reader that aborts on shutdown; reached through every HTTP request

internal_only.reason: Created by server.py main at engine start; loads timer_seconds
